text: Step 5 · Test plan — Regional Data-Center Failover.

text.text:
*1 · Trigger & declaration*
• Validate the outage alert
• Declare a BC event and open the war room
• Notify the BC team and executives

*2 · Failover execution*
• Fail over core systems to the secondary region
• Verify data integrity at the recovery point
• Confirm critical apps are serving traffic

*3 · Communication*
• Update staff on system status
• Brief customer-facing teams with holding lines

*4 · Validation & return*
• Measure RTO / RPO against the plan
• Plan the return to primary
• Log evidence for the report
